CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Summer-2014 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Summer-2014 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 581 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 9 benchmark sites in 1 regions spanning 1 states (survey period: December 2013 to December 2013). These surveys captured 26 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 3 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 780 cards across 21 sites, with 4.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (38 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 126 transects across 21 sites (survey period: December 2013 to February 2014), detecting active burrows in 7.1% of transects (total: 42 active burrows).
